name: Saltline Hotels
tagline: Small hotels by the water in Lisbon, Copenhagen and Barcelona.
description: Saltline is a group of three hotels, each in a restored building a few minutes from the water: a 1920s shipping office in Lisbon's Santos, a harbour-front warehouse in Copenhagen and a Gothic Quarter townhouse in Barcelona. Between 48 and 62 rooms each, a restaurant led by a local chef, and a small team who will plan your days if you let them. A fourth hotel opens in Marseille in spring 2027.

styles.label: Design and culture
styles.description: Galleries, architecture, studios and the people who make things. Guests who book the museum before the restaurant.

styles.label: Food and wine
styles.description: Market mornings, chef's tables, natural wine and the long lunch. The restaurant is the reason for the trip.

styles.label: Slow and quiet
styles.description: Longer stays, bigger rooms, a terrace, a book. Days with one plan at most.

styles.label: Active and outdoors
styles.description: Harbour swims, surf mornings, sailing and long walks. Back for breakfast with salt in your hair.
